gaps.lead: The athlete insisted that she had never taken banned substances.
gaps.explanation: deny having + past participle denies an earlier action.

gaps.lead: The rescue team managed to reach the village by helicopter.
gaps.sentence: The rescue team ___ the village by helicopter.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = succeed IN doing.

gaps.lead: The doctor persuaded me to promise that I would exercise daily.
gaps.sentence: The doctor ___ that I would exercise daily.
gaps.explanation: get somebody TO do something = persuade/make them.

gaps.lead: The doctor said that he should take a complete rest.
gaps.sentence: The doctor advised ___ a complete rest.
gaps.explanation: say + should → advise + object + to-infinitive: advised him to take.

gaps.lead: I wish I had never told her the secret.
gaps.explanation: wish + past perfect ≈ shouldn't have + participle.

gaps.lead: The ceremony will take place in the cathedral.
gaps.explanation: Ceremonies are held: will be held (in a venue).
